summary.plain: A wall of 1022 lead-fluoride crystals around the beam that counts individual scattered electrons at very high rates, together with a liquid-hydrogen target and monitors that watch the beam and target for tiny false asymmetries.
summary.technical: A4: total-absorption PbF2 Cherenkov calorimeter (1022 crystals in 7 rings, energies summed over clusters of nine crystals, event rate about 100 MHz), 10 cm liquid-hydrogen target, luminosity monitors and microwave-resonator beam monitors, used at forward (30-40 degree) and backward (140-150 degree) angles.
